correctness.rationale: For two area-uniform points in a nondegenerate parallelogram, affine-coordinate differences are independent triangular variables with exact even moments 1/6, 1/15, 1/28. Binomial expansion gives three displayed formulas, from which the 41 determinant reconstructs product of squared side lengths and squared cosine. Positive-root conditions are necessary and sufficient for a genuine parallelogram, including equal sides and right angles. The exact noncongruent pair shares M2,M4 but differs in M6. 1200 exact rational reconstructions, four independent polynomial integrations and 600000 simulated pairs passed; the universal proof does not rely on simulation.

evidence: Tong and Pan (arxiv:1602.03407v1) give a forward distance-distribution algorithm for arbitrary polygons, not a three-moment shape-identification theorem.
The public published-finding corpus width-reconstruction RESULT.md determines a parallelogram using the mean, second moment and support maximum of random projection widths, not pair-distance moments.
Sheng 1985 forward moment formula is potentially stronger as a source of explicit moments, but no accessible statement asserts finite inverse identifiability.
broader_coverage.reasoning: General forward distance formulas contain enough information to compute moments, but do not by themselves establish that these particular three moments suffice or that two fail. A projection-width triple is not a function of the interior two-point distance moment triple by any checked reduction. The available sources therefore do not dominate the inverse theorem as statements.

The unrelated width data and antipodal boundary data cannot be assumed to equal independent interior two-point distance moments. The new nonzero 41-determinant identity links three interior moments and yields a feasible region and a sharp exact two-moment collision.

originality.rationale: The forward interior fourth-distance moment and general distance-distribution formulas are prior art; full text of the closest 2011 rhombus study and two public parallelogram findings does not give a three-initial-even-moment inverse with a complete feasible region and exact two-moment obstruction. The oldest highly relevant Sheng 1985 full text was inaccessible, leaving a material residual priority risk. These searches support provisional originality but not uniqueness certification.
residual_risks: T. K. Sheng (1985) is highly relevant and plausible: full text inaccessible due authorization/VPN status, so a hidden inversion cannot be excluded.

The older own antipodal boundary sampling theorem is similar as a three-moment inverse of the same shape family, though not a logical implication for independent interior pairs. The value here depends on treating the natural interior-observation problem separately.
Unindexed older recognition results or a corollary in general distance-moment literature may exist; not a certification of global novelty.

value.rationale: Uniform independent area-point distances are a natural geometric-probability observable. The theorem gives an exact necessary-and-sufficient characterization of all realizable triples and a constructive complete inverse for the three-parameter family of positive-area parallelograms. A genuine exact two-moment counterexample makes the cutoff sharp. It is not a mere table value or an arbitrary slice; no unsupported statistical stability claim is made.
